caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a male figure, dressed in long brown robes with sculpted folds, standing on a rectangular base. The figure has short black hair, a beard, and holds a black cross in his left hand while his right hand is open and raised. The statue is framed by an arched structure with angular, zig-zagged sides, all rendered in a brownish hue to suggest wood. On each side of the base, there is a green, leafy plant, possibly meant to depict palm fronds. The background is plain, off-white, and there are no other objects or decorations visible in the drawing. The artist’s signature and some faint handwritten notes are present at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Santo (St. Francis)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
